# symbolicParameterJacobianTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicParameterJacobianTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicParameterJacobianTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The parameters as an input of the symbolic system (#3159): a user rigid body of the inertia of rho and L on a
#           revolute joint, a spring-damper of stiffness k on it and a mass point of mass m, created by UserItemCreator
#           with the variables of mbs.symbolicVariables. SymbolicSystem records the composed system and the functions of
#           the joints and connectors once, with the parameters as their input p: SetParameterValues sets new values
#           without recording again, and the forces, the mass matrix, the Jacobians, the constraints and the reaction
#           forces then equal those of a system built anew - composed and item by item. ODE2RHSParameterJacobian and
#           MassMatrixParameterJacobian, the derivatives by p, equal central differences.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-03
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.symbolics.systemModel import SymbolicSystem
import numpy as np
esym = exu.symbolic

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()
rho = esym.Real('rho', 1000., scope=mbs)
L = esym.Real('L', 0.4, scope=mbs)
k = esym.Real('k', 500., scope=mbs)
m = esym.Real('m', 0.5, scope=mbs)

creator = UserItemCreator(mbs)
ground = creator.CreateGround()
inertia = InertiaCuboid(density=rho, sideLengths=[L, 0.1, 0.05]).Translated([0.5*L, 0, 0])
body = creator.CreateRigidBody(inertia=inertia, referencePosition=[0, 0, 0], initialAngularVelocity=[0, 0, 2.],
                               gravity=[0, -9.81, 0], nodeType=exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz)
creator.CreateRevoluteJoint(itemNumbers=[ground, body], position=[0, 0, 0], axis=[0, 0.2, 1])
creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[ground, body], localPosition0=[0.5, 0.2, 0], localPosition1=[0.3, 0, 0], stiffness=k, damping=2)
point = creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[0.6, -0.3, 0.2], mass=m, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0])
creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[body, point], localPosition0=[0.4, 0, 0], stiffness=k/2, damping=1)
creator.Record()
mbs.Assemble()
bindings = creator.parameterBindings

composed = SymbolicSystem(mbs, parameters=bindings)
itemByItem = SymbolicSystem(mbs, composeSystem=False, parameters=bindings)
failed = int(sorted(composed.parameterNames) != ['L', 'k', 'm', 'rho'])
rng = np.random.default_rng(5)
(q0, q_t0) = composed.InitialState()
(q, q_t, q_tt) = (q0 + 0.05*rng.standard_normal(composed.nODE2), q_t0 + 0.3*rng.standard_normal(composed.nODE2),
                  rng.standard_normal(composed.nODE2))
(t, y, z) = (0.1, np.zeros(0), rng.standard_normal(composed.nAE))

def Results(system):
    return [system.ODE2RHS(q, q_t, t), system.MassMatrix(q, q_t, t),
            system.ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(q, q_t, q_tt, t, factor_q=1., factor_q_t=0.3),
            system.AlgebraicEquations(q, q_t, y, z, t), system.ODE2ReactionForcesLHS(q, q_t, y, z, t)]
for system in [composed, itemByItem]: #the item functions recorded with the first values
    Results(system)

#new values without recording again, against the systems built anew
recordings = (composed.composed['ODE2RHS'], composed.composed['massMatrix'])
values = {'rho': 1200., 'L': 0.45, 'k': 650., 'm': 0.8}
differences = []
for (system, composeSystem) in [(composed, True), (itemByItem, False)]:
    system.SetParameterValues(values)
    built = SymbolicSystem(mbs, composeSystem=composeSystem, parameters=bindings)
    differences += [np.max(np.abs(a - b)) for (a, b) in zip(Results(system), Results(built))]
exu.Print('SetParameterValues against the systems built anew:', max(differences))
failed += int(not max(differences) < 1e-12)
failed += int(composed.composed['ODE2RHS'] is not recordings[0] or composed.composed['massMatrix'] is not recordings[1])
exu.Print('the mass of the body:', mbs.GetObject(body)['parameters'][0], '= rho*L*0.1*0.05 =', 1200.*0.45*0.1*0.05)
failed += int(abs(mbs.GetObject(body)['parameters'][0] - 1200.*0.45*0.1*0.05) > 1e-12)

#the derivatives by the parameters against central differences
dF = composed.ODE2RHSParameterJacobian(q, q_t, t)
dM = composed.MassMatrixParameterJacobian(q, q_t, t)
differences = []
for (j, name) in enumerate(composed.parameterNames):
    epsilon = 1e-6*values[name]
    results = []
    for sign in [1, -1]:
        composed.SetParameterValues({name: values[name] + sign*epsilon})
        results.append((composed.ODE2RHS(q, q_t, t), composed.MassMatrix(q, q_t, t)))
    composed.SetParameterValues({name: values[name]})
    for (derivative, central) in [(dF[:, j], (results[0][0] - results[1][0])/(2*epsilon)),
                                  (dM[j], (results[0][1] - results[1][1])/(2*epsilon))]:
        differences.append(np.max(np.abs(derivative - central))/max(1., np.max(np.abs(central))))
exu.Print('derivatives by the parameters against central differences:', max(differences))
failed += int(not max(differences) < 1e-6)

u = failed
exu.Print('solution of symbolicParameterJacobianTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
